summary: Added GFM table rendering to tools/blog.mjs's hand-rolled markdown renderer (header/delimiter/body rows, per-column alignment :---/:---:/---:, backtick-aware pipe splitting so a pipe inside inline code in a cell doesn't split it, \| escaping), wrapped in a .tblwrap div that scrolls horizontally on its own instead of the page body. Swept all 66 published posts: 12 had real GFM tables (delimiter row present, not just stray pipes in prose) and all now render correctly. Built a general leaked/mangled-markdown detector (detectMarkdownLeakage) that scans rendered HTML for signatures of unsupported constructs and runs on every normal build (warns, non-fatal per rule 13) plus a --self-test with two arms that must disagree: a fully-supported-construct document renders clean with zero detector hits, and an unsupported-construct document is caught and named by the detector, not silently passed through. Confirmed the control is not inert: disabled the table-detection branch, reran --self-test, watched it go red; restored, reran, green again.

verification.self_test: node tools/blog.mjs --self-test -> PASS, exit 0 (21 assertions, arm A all pass + zero leaks, arm B all 3 named gaps caught)
verification.delete_the_fix: commented out the table-detection condition (`if (false && ...)`), reran --self-test: 3 explicit FAILs plus an uncaught TypeError from the now-absent <tbody> -- confirmed the instrument goes red, not inert. Restored, reran: PASS again.
verification.full_build: node tools/blog.mjs -> '66 post(s), status 64 verdict(s), 0 leak(s) -> docs/index.html'
verification.table_count_in_output: grep -c 'class="tblwrap"' docs/index.html -> 14 (12 posts, 2 of which carry two tables each)
verification.false_positive_correction: first cut of the mangled-image-title detector matched ]*"[^>]*> anywhere in the tag and flagged 13 posts whose *alt* text legitimately quotes dialogue (e.g. alt="..."Jackdaws-Love-My..."") -- not a bug, correct escaping of a real quotation. Narrowed the regex to (scoped to the SRC attribute specifically, which is where the image-title bug actually lands the leaked quote marks). Rerun: 0 false positives across all 66 posts, self-test's arm B (a genuine title-in-parens image) still caught.

findings: CONFIRMED BUG, sweep count: 12 of 66 published posts under docs/blog/*.md contain a real GFM table (delimiter row present, e.g. `|---|---:|`), not just prose that happens to contain a pipe character. Full list: 2026-08-07-three-mistakes-that-are-mine.md, 2026-08-08-a-body-walked-the-whole-province.md, 2026-08-08-a-number-i-had-not-checked.md, 2026-08-08-a-third-of-every-edge-in-the-interface.md, 2026-08-08-the-arm-that-never-cut-the-walls.md, 2026-08-08-the-bolt-that-could-not-hit-anything-moving.md, 2026-08-08-the-facility-built-to-catch-a-fake-control-had-one-of-its-own.md (the one named in the brief), 2026-08-08-the-guard-you-can-outwalk.md, 2026-08-08-two-things-were-stopping-you-from-making-a-character.md, 2026-08-08-what-a-forged-save-can-and-cannot-put-on-the-map.md, 2026-08-08-what-we-said-was-broken-checked-again.md, 2026-08-08-you-can-open-every-screen-now.md. All 12 render correctly after the fix and are visible with real <table> markup in the regenerated docs/index.html. 'At least one' was a floor -- the real count is 12.

SUPPORTED (verified via self-test + real corpus): headings, bold/italic, inline code, links, images (incl. hard-wrap-joined alt text), blockquotes (incl. hard-wrapped), unordered lists with wrapped continuation lines, fenced code blocks, :::compare blocks, and now GFM tables with per-column alignment, escaped pipes, and pipe-inside-inline-code cells that must NOT split the cell.

DROPPED, VISIBLE (unsupported, shows as literal unconverted text -- a reader notices immediately): footnote syntax `text[^1]` / `[^1]: def` passes through as literal brackets. Confirmed present in 0 of 66 published posts.

SILENTLY MANGLED, the dangerous category (verified by direct md() calls; not present in any of the 66 published posts today but real and reproducible against the renderer as shipped): (1) nested lists -- `- top\n - nested` merges the nested bullet's marker and text straight into the PARENT
  • as plain text (`
  • top - nested
    • `), reading as one bullet with a stray hyphen rather than two levels; the renderer's list logic treats any indented line as a wrapped-continuation of the line above with no distinction from a genuine nested marker. (2) image titles -- `![alt](x.png "title")`: the image regex's `[^)]+` swallows the quoted title straight into `src`, producing ``, a broken (404) image path with no error anywhere. (3) links whose URL contains a literal `)` -- `[text](http://x/wiki/Foo_(disambiguation))`: the link regex's `[^)]+` stops at the URL's own first `)`, truncating the href and stranding the source's closing paren as a visible stray `)` immediately after the rendered link. (4) fenced code language tags (```js) are silently dropped -- no `class="language-js"` reaches the `` element -- harmless today since this renderer never did syntax highlighting, but noted as a real, if low-stakes, silent drop.

None of the four SILENTLY MANGLED / dropped constructs above (nested lists, footnotes, image titles, parens-in-URL links) are used anywhere in the current 66 published posts -- confirmed by direct grep for each pattern across docs/blog/*.md. They are latent, not live damage. Reported per the brief's instruction to check the renderer itself, not just today's content.

Not fixed this round, by deliberate scope decision: nested-list nesting, footnote rendering, image-title attributes, and parenthesized link URLs. None currently ships broken content (see above), and the brief's mandatory deliverable was tables plus a working detection mechanism, which now exists and catches three of these four the moment any post actually uses them (all but nested lists, which produces no HTML signature the detector can key on without false-positiving on ordinary hyphenated prose).

The detectMarkdownLeakage() mechanism now runs on every normal `node tools/blog.mjs` build (prints warnings per post, non-fatal) in addition to --self-test, so the 'silent' half of the original defect -- not just the missing table renderer -- has a running check, per the brief's point that a fix which only adds tables leaves the mechanism intact for the next construct.
not_done: Nested list support, footnote rendering, image titles, and parenthesized link URLs were diagnosed and reported but not implemented -- none is live in the current 66 posts, and the brief scoped the required fix to tables plus a real detection mechanism.

detectMarkdownLeakage() is NOT wired into the pre-commit hook (rule 13 -- a fail-closed gate on another agent's in-flight post write has stopped this box before); it runs as a warning in the normal build and as a hard assertion only under --self-test.
Fenced code language-tag class (`class="language-js"`) is not carried through to the rendered <code> element -- noted as a minor, currently cosmetic-only gap, not fixed.
